title: External Application Accuracy Contract and Runtime Policy Seam Closeout

qualified_capability.purpose: Carry and validate externally supplied application accuracy and temporal allocation policy, then materialize only their composed temporal budget into the pre-existing generic canonical numerical carrier.
qualified_capability.H_app: must be positive, finite, explicitly available, externally qualified and provenance-bound
qualified_capability.A_temporal: must be positive, finite, <= 1, explicitly available, externally qualified and provenance-bound

remediation_provenance.material_source_defect_found_and_fixed: Fortran logical expressions are not guaranteed to short-circuit. NaN validation originally allowed a relational comparison to be evaluated after ieee_is_finite had returned false, causing SIGFPE under invalid-operation traps. Validation is now sequential and trap-safe.
other_red_findings: test compile rejected direct REAL equality checks under -Werror
shell source-structure assertion lagged behind the trap-safe equivalent upper-bound guard

architecture_result.multiSWAP_rule: compact IDs/scalars may be shared/batched; provenance documents and project strings remain outside per-column persistent state
architecture_result.mass_contract: q_SWAP = -q_GW remains absolute and is not traded against head-accuracy policy

hard_nonclaims: no claim that a regulatory threshold equals model prediction accuracy
no claim that F-GC07 temporal characterization is a universal physical error bound
exact_head_requirement: The commit introducing this closeout must itself pass the F-GC09 application accuracy contract qualification workflow. Only that exact green closeout head is the F-GC09 closeout authority.
